text: Organizational metrics, such as the number of developers working on a component, organizational distance between developers, and organizational code ownership, are better predictors of defect proneness than traditional metrics like churn, complexity, coverage, dependencies, and pre release bug measures.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
